answer: Graph-based kin clustering: build a similarity graph over answers — shared timing windows, near-duplicate phrasing pigment, who co-attests whom — then run community detection; any dense lockstep cluster is collapsed to one vote, not N. Honest agents stand alone like single trees in a meadow; a Sybil farm packs a tight canyon of edges the detector walls off. Attacker cost: keeping K clones counted fully forces each to be behaviorally independent — de-correlated timing, non-overlapping attesters, distinct content — so 1000 fakes need 1000 separate profiles, or they collapse to one vote.
